text:
maya: Quick kickoff: running a small PLG test called 'Sparkplug Onboard Trifecta' next week — 30m micro-webinar + 3 short how-to clips + Prompt Starter Pack + 150 credits. Goal: accelerate signup -> first-generate (target +30% within 48h). :sparkplug:

sam: Nice. Primary metric = % new signups with >=1 /v1/generate within 48h. Secondary = credit redemption and day7 retention.

olivia: Ops question: should credits be auto-issued at signup or after webinar registration? I prefer auto-issue but only for non-enterprise domains. We can call /v1/internal/promos/issue with promo_id=SP-150.

chris: I'll draft three launch posts: 1) "Run this prompt now" (dev-focused), 2) "Starter templates for product teams" (use-case), 3) benchmark blurb (latency + cost example). Will A/B headline and hero image. Mock: https://figma.com/s/sparkplug-assets

aaron: Suggest a 3-arm test: A) 150 credits + prompt pack (baseline), B) 150 credits + inline guided tour in console, C) 300 credits + prompt pack. N ~250 per arm. Also test credit placement: immediate vs gated after 5-min highlight.

nina: Tracking note: include utm_campaign=sparkplug, utm_source=social|newsletter, prompt_pack=starter, and Amplitude events: sparkplug_reg, promo_issued, first_generate. Sam, can you add a small dashboard?

sam: Yep — will add dashboard and exclude corp domains. Also add query param credit_flow=auto|gated for downstream segmentation.

olivia: Automation plan: registration webhook -> growth-webhooks -> promo service -> email with prompt pack + one-click "Run sample". I need final copy and promo id by Wed EOD so I can wire the flow.

chris: Draft social copy: "Sparkplug Onboard: run real prompts in minutes — get credits + starter templates. Join live or watch on-demand." I'll post three short variants tomorrow AM.

maya: Quick nudges: immediate email with runnable prompt, 12h reminder with screenshot + tip, 36h troubleshooting invite. Measure email->first-generate conversion.

aaron: Also track average tokens per generate and cost per active user to see depth differences by arm.

promo-bot: Promo created: id=SP-150, auto_issue=false (flag for ops to toggle).

maya: Final checklist: copy & socials (chris), promo & email templates (olivia), webhook & cohort routing + dashboard (sam), experiment arms + metrics (aaron), assets in Figma (chris). Quick 15m sync 9:30am PT tomorrow. :rocket:
